caption: Chain slack, step by step, with the tools, the checks and the photos. One of 370 free repair guides. Link in bio.

caption: Standard, cruiser, cafe racer, motocross, boda boda and more: what each is good for and how they are built. Link in bio.

caption: A two-stroke motocross bike on the turntable, then into the engine: ports, piston and expansion chamber, all in 3D. Link in bio.

title: Step-through, explained
caption: The world's best-selling motorcycle layout. Spin it, then tap the clutch to see how it engages. Link in bio.

title: Boda boda
caption: The workhorse of East Africa in 3D. Tap the chain and sprockets to see how the drive works and how to look after it. Link in bio.

title: The first motorcycles
caption: A 1901 motor-bicycle: an engine bolted into a bicycle frame. Spin it, then look inside the engine. Link in bio.

title: Inside the e-motor
caption: Tap the motor of an electric motorcycle and watch the rotor turn. Magnets, windings and shaft, all named. Link in bio.

title: Superbike brakes
caption: A floating disc and a four-piston radial caliper, turning in 3D. Every part named. Link in bio.

title: V-twin engine
caption: The big air-cooled V-twin of a cruiser, from the outside in. Spin the bike, then open the engine. Link in bio.

caption: The flywheel magnets spin round the stator coils to charge the battery and run the lights. Link in bio.

caption: Starter motor, reduction gears and one-way clutch spin the crank until the engine fires. Then the clutch freewheels. Link in bio.

title: Final drive
caption: In gear, the countershaft turns the front sprocket and the chain. In neutral it stands still. Link in bio.

title: Kick start, real time
caption: Kick the lever: a spline slides the kick gear into mesh and spins the crank through the primary drive. Link in bio.

caption: Every part of a running single, pulled apart in 3D and labelled. Crank, piston, clutch, gearbox and generator. Link in bio.
